source_title: 딜템 다 양보하고 힐템입고 만렙찍으면 이렇게됨
subtitle: 1레벨부터 딜템 싹 양보하고 만렙 찍은 착한 사제의 장비창 대참사

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
주문력 반지요?
전 힐러니까 딜러님
먼저 드시라고 양보할게요!
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder (OTS) diagonal shot from behind the shoulder and feathered hood of the Skyborne Mage girl on the right. On the lower-left, the Night Elf Priest girl (bottom-row #2 on Draft C cast sheet) bows politely with an angelic halo, gently sliding a glowing blue magical ring across the flat top of a wooden dungeon loot chest with a pure sweet smile. 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background, medium 2.5-to-3-head chibi scale, top 35% pure white headroom. Zero text, zero digits, zero speech bubbles.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
필드 퀘스트 보상 녹템도
생각보다 튼튼해요!
전 파티 힐만 열심히~
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile 90-degree action shot on a 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background. On the left, the Night Elf Priest girl is skipping cheerfully past with puffed proud cheeks, wearing a brown leather pirate eyepatch over one eye and clutching a patched low-level cloth robe, wearing a bright innocent grin. On the right, the Human Warlock girl stands watching with arms crossed and an incredulous squinting side-eye. Medium 2.5-to-3-head chibi scale, generous white headroom. Zero text, zero digits, zero speech bubbles.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
드디어 감격의 60 만렙 달성!!
고생한 내 캐릭터 장비창
어디 한번 구경해 볼까~♪
cuts.visual_prompt: Dramatic low-angle shot looking up at the Night Elf Priest girl (bottom-row #2 on Draft C cast sheet) on a 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background. She is leaping into the air with golden celebration sparkle rays surrounding her, both arms raised high in triumphant victory, ecstatic blushing smile with tears of joy, her leather pirate eyepatch and ragged tabard flapping! Medium 2.5-to-3-head chibi scale in lower two-thirds, top 35% pure white headroom. Zero text, zero digits.

Dynamic Dutch tilt diagonal angle frame with tilted camera on a 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background, recreating the exact gear screen from the original screenshot! The Night Elf Priest girl holds an open parchment character stats sheet, staring down in absolute horror! Her jaw drops all the way down, eyes spinning in dizzy black-and-white whirlpool spirals, her body tilted sideways in paralyzed disbelief, cartoon shock impact lines bursting around her head. Zero text, zero digits.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
손목이 24렙 초록템에
전체 주문력이 30렙 수준?!
착하게 살았는데 이게 뭐야!!
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle shot looking down at the Night Elf Priest girl collapsed on the ground, clutching her head in agony with waterfall anime tears flooding the floor on a 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background. Beside her, the Skyborne Mage girl kneels down awkwardly, scratching her cheek with an embarrassed, guilty sweat drop. Medium 2.5-to-3-head chibi scale, top 35% pure white headroom. Zero text, zero digits, zero speech bubbles.

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
잠깐… 저기 차고 있는 가죽
안대 보상템 멋진데요?
…어디서 얻으신 거예요?!
cuts.visual_prompt: Back-view shot on a 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background. In the foreground, the Human Warlock girl stands seen from behind with her demonic horned hood, turning her head back over her shoulder with an enthusiastic sparkle in her eye, pointing admiringly at the priest's stylish pirate eyepatch instead of caring about the stats! In the background, the Night Elf Priest facepalms in helpless exasperation. Medium 2.5-to-3-head chibi scale, top 34% pure white headroom. Zero text, zero digits.
